channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dwight Powell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dwight Powell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Dwight Powell
item.description:
Landon Thomas:Spencer Dinwiddie:

“I hope every single Mavs fan listens to this monologue and has a different respect level for (Dwight Powell).”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Dwight Powell, Dec 3, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dwight Powell
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle:

“I don’t see any difference now from the Dwight Powell before the [Achilles] injury, and that just speaks to an amazing amount of work put in.”

Rick Carlisle on Dwight Powell, Apr 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dwight Powell
item.description:
Brad Townsend:Carlisle on whether Dwight Powell's noticeable uptick is evidence he's getting his legs under him:

“Early in the season I don't think he was feeling himself. I don't think he you don't want to go through COVID to get your legs, but in some ways it seems to have helped him.”

Rick Carlisle on Dwight Powell, Feb 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on James Johnson, Josh Richardson, Dwight Powell
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Mavs getting tougher 4 this SZN:

“Dwight Powell was 1 of our tougher guys last year. He's back now. That gives us toughness. James Johnson has multiple ratings in the martial arts. He gives us toughness. Josh Richardson is an edgy guy who is a terrific defender.”

Rick Carlisle on James Johnson, Josh Richardson, Dwight Powell, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dwight Powell
item.description:
Carlisle on Powell being back tonight:

“We know he's going to help us. We really need help at both ends. As well as we’ve played during stretches offensively, you can always do better. Defensively is where we need a lift. We need his power, we need his force, we need his energy.”

Rick Carlisle on Dwight Powell, Oct 29, 2019. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dwight Powell
item.description:
Eddie Sefko:Rick Carlisle on Dwight Powell:

“Powell went through a full practice today. He's doing better, he's getting closer. That's all I'm going to say about it.”

Rick Carlisle on Dwight Powell, Oct 28, 2019. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Jae Crowder on Dwight Powell, Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Jae Crowder on the Rajon Rondo trade to Dallas:

“It was a blessing in disguise for me and Dwight Powell. I can tell you that.”

Jae Crowder on Dwight Powell, Rajon Rondo, Nov 18, 2015. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.
